avis.titre: No longer a holy grail product
avis.texte: I HAD loved this exfoliator for years now, and have purchased it many times. The packaging had changed every so often, but the formula didn't. It WAS a lovely minty product, lightweight with no heavy, greasy oils and the finest of grain exfoliating particles that buffed my sensitive skin well without feeling damaging. HOWEVER, that being said. They have obviously CHANGED the product's formula in the past year or so since I last purchased- and it is now not only formulated with higher amount of lemon/citrus oil, but also with a significant reduction in the amount of exfoliating particulates. The increased cloying lemon scent, increased oiliness that clings to my skin even after washing the product off, and reduction in exfoliating ability, leaves me absolutely baffled and disappointed; as I believed I was re-purchasing the same product as usual. It's an expensive product! I don't have time or money for a brand that is constantly messing around with it's packaging and formulas. I know from reading reviews on other websites that I am not the only one who feels this way. I will be looking for a new holy grail exfoliator.
